content.title: Chapter 86 - RETIREMENT — Sec. 86-79. - Records and reports.
content.summary:
The secretary of the board shall keep, or cause to be kept, such data as shall be
               necessary for actuarial evaluation of the liabilities of the retirement system. The
               board shall render a report to the council at least annually.
(Code 1960, § 19-3; Code 1981, § 26-35)
